Title: WHAT ONLY THIS TEAM CAN DO
Detail_lesson: Every team can list what it delivers. Fewer can say what would go missing if the team disappeared tomorrow.
CustomInstruction: Finish this sentence in one line: if this team vanished, the organization would lose ______. Name something no other team could pick up, and resist listing deliverables.

Title: HOW WE WILL KNOW WE WON
Detail_lesson: Twelve months out, what does success look like in numbers and in things you can see?
CustomInstruction: Give one number and one observable behaviour. Both must be inside this team's control — if a different team could ruin it, pick something else.

Title: OUR NON-NEGOTIABLES
Detail_lesson: The handful of working rules that hold even when the schedule slips.
CustomInstruction: Give two rules, phrased as things we always do or never do. Draw each one from something that actually went wrong on a team you were on.

Title: HOW WE HANDLE DISAGREEMENT
Detail_lesson: Technical, interpersonal and strategic conflicts need different paths, and the difference is usually noticed too late.
CustomInstruction: Pick one type of conflict and describe the escalation path end to end: who is involved, who decides, and how long it is allowed to stay open.

Title: THE GAPS THAT WILL STOP US
Detail_lesson: Capabilities the team will need for what is coming, not for what it does today.
CustomInstruction: Name one skill gap and the deadline it becomes a problem. Then say whether you would hire, train or borrow it, and why that choice.
